name: Datamuse
tagline: Word-finding API for rhymes, synonyms, and constrained word search
description: Datamuse is a free word-finding API for developers. It returns English words matching constraints such as meaning relatedness, sound-alike (rhymes), spelling similarity, and letter patterns. Common uses include writing tools, crossword helpers, games, and NLP demos. No authentication is required for basic use; commercial use may need permission.

auth.details: No API key required for typical use; requests are made as plain GET queries. Heavy or commercial use may require contacting the operator.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Up to 100,000 requests per day without a key until January 1, 2027; thereafter an API key is required with a 100,000-request daily limit per key.

rate_limits: 100,000 requests/day; beyond that, requests may be rate-limited without notice. From January 1, 2027, an API key is required and the same daily limit applies per key.
use_cases: look up synonyms or related words
constrained word search by spelling pattern
suggest similar-sounding words for writing tools
